text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Furioso's suggestion, we went all the 
way out to Funabashi today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*, *exhale*... Nothing beats the 
air back home, does it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(—Having said that... That isn't my only 
goal for today.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Actually... I brought a present to give 
to Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(A gift of gratitude for Trainer, who has 
been with me all the way since my 
Funabashi days—it should be given in 
Funabashi, where it all started for us.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Still... I heard it's best to give things 
like this as a surprise— Honesty, that 
kind of thing is really not my strong 
suit.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Anyway, is there somewhere we could get 
into the right mood...?)
choice_data_list:
For now, I'll treat you at my regular 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Familiar Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my goodness, if it isn't Furioso-chan 
and her Trainer! What'll you have today?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Katsu curry and ramen... extra large 
servings, please.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...I ended up getting treated to a meal 
before I even realized it.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, this place holds memories too, 
so maybe it's fine to give it to them now? 
...If I give it now—)

text_block_list.name: Familiar Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Here you go, Trainer. Tanmen and fried 
rice."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "And this is a present from me!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Better not. It's too sudden, Trainer 
would be troubled...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —As always, the scenery here is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah. Here should be fine. Alright... 
let's give it to them...!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Local Friend
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaa!? It's Furioso! You're back!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: !? A-Ah, l-long time no—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...This is bad. Running into people I 
know, missing my timing— I'm running out 
of time.)
choice_data_list:
I used to run along this road all the 
time.

I used to run along this road all the 
time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Usually, I hydrate at 
that vending machine over there, and—
choice_data_list: Since we're here, let's grab some drinks!

Since we have the chance, shall we buy 
some drinks?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Stupid me! Far from giving a present, 
I've just been on the receiving end from 
Trainer...!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh!? No way!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I-It's true... The cream soda turned into 
melon soda...!
choice_data_list:
...Even the scenery of our memories 
changes over time, huh.

...Even the scenery of our memories 
changes over time, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: You're right... ......

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? Wait, is the mood right now 
actually getting pretty good...?!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"However... there are things that never 
change as well."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That is... our feelings for Funabashi. 
And—our bond!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(............ Is this really a good 
atmosphere? ...I don't know, but there's 
no more time— Anyway, I just have to give 
it to them!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then... I took out the present I had 
prepared and handed it to Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso has believed in me and stood by my 
side, both then and now—this is a small 
token of my gratitude to her. I'm sure 
she'll be delighted—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Why?! Why are you doing this sort of 
thing right now?!
choice_data_list: No... I just thought the timing was right.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No need to apologize! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I've had enough! Let's just go home for 
today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the end—on the train ride home, 
Furioso abruptly handed me a present as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Good timing" for what?! It's not good at 
all! Do you have any idea how I felt...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "...Jeez! Here! Take this! From me too!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
………… I'll be counting on you from now on, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't quite catch everything, but 
the look on Furioso's face said she didn't 
mind at all.
